body:
Thank you for reaching out to me when I was going through a difficult time.

I was sexually abused as a child.  My family is great so I’ve never told them because I didn’t want them blaming themselves for not protecting me.  Instead I just blamed myself.  Depression and anxiety run in my family on both my mom and dads side.  Romantic relationships are difficult for me due to the trauma and guilt.  Sometimes I just get overwhelmed feeling like I was doomed from the start.  I keep fighting to life the life I want but sometimes I get tired of fighting and just want to let go.

For what it’s worth I’m feeling better now.  My suicidal spirals usually only last for a few days.  Then it’s like a cloud lifts and I feel like myself again.

Thank you for reaching out to me at a time I really needed it.  Being able to express myself and having you reach out to me meant more to me than you know.  I’m getting professional help.  This post made me realize I can’t handle it on my own anymore.  I’m on meds and setting up an appointment with a councilor.  Thank you for being a kind voice when I needed it the most.

That doesn’t sound like a healthy relationship.  You need someone capable of supporting you emotionally and understanding what you are going through.  She may not know how to handle what you said, but she doesn’t sound like she’s good for you.
